quarterly_data.quarter: CIG Shanghai results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual collective (05-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Chairman and general manager Gerald G Wong (2025 annual collective results briefing): the company's annualised optical module capacity is currently 350 ten-thousand units; demand for its high-speed modules is strong and capacity utilisation stays high, and it is expanding its domestic and overseas production bases in line with market demand and customer orders to secure 800G and 1.6T deliveries. VP and board secretary Jin Zeqing said the company had foreseen upstream supply tightness and tied itself to several suppliers of silicon-photonics chips, CW light sources, DSPs and Faraday rotators for isolators through supply-assurance agreements, directed fixed-asset investment and direct or indirect equity investment, locking in supply and upstream capacity, with reasonable reserves of key materials and capacity currently running at high load; he cautioned that industry-wide material tightness persists and is somewhat unpredictable.
quarterly_data.figure: annualised optical module capacity 350 ten-thousand units

quarterly_data.quarter: CIG Shanghai results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual collective (05-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Chairman Gerald G Wong (2025 annual collective results briefing): the company's 1.6T high-speed optical modules have completed small-batch supply, and batch shipments will be arranged according to customer demand; its R&D and production focus on 800G/1.6T modules, mainly on silicon photonics, for data-center interconnect and AI compute. In his view 800G remains the market's main product with a high shipment share, while 1.6T has entered scaled mass production and accelerating penetration since 2026. Coherent modules: the company has technology reserves but they are a small share of revenue. He declined to give order guidance.

quarterly_data.quarter: CIG Shanghai results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual collective (05-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Chairman Gerald G Wong on next-generation technology (2025 annual collective results briefing): the company is extending its pluggable 1.6T modules to 6km and 10km reach for scale-across and campus use; its NPO/CPO work covers optical engines, multi-channel silicon-photonics modulators, advanced packaging and external light sources for 102.4T and 204.8T total-bandwidth systems, shown with partners at OFC 2026 (a demonstration); it recently stepped up work on 12.8T XPO and is developing 400G-per-lane modules on thin-film lithium niobate. It cooperates with upstream and downstream partners through strategic cooperation, joint development and minority stakes, and its Hsinchu (Taiwan) R&D center works on new optical module technology.
quarterly_data.figure: 102.4T and 204.8T NPO/CPO bandwidth; 12.8T XPO; 400G-per-lane TFLN; 1.6T reach 6km and 10km
